 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Oct 25, 2026, 04:15 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Libra’s ruler gets a much-needed boost on Kojagari Purnima. Venus, which rules your sign, sits retrograde on your lagna and has only just passed its meeting with the Sun, so its light remains faint. Tonight’s Lakshmi worship is the traditional way to support it, since the goddess and Venus share the domain of grace and prosperity. The full Moon shines from Aries, your seventh, facing your sign directly. Lakshmi Worship and Your Ruler
 Venus on the lagna shapes appearance and self-worth. While it is weak, you may feel less confident than usual. Worshipping Lakshmi tonight with a lotus and a ghee lamp is believed to restore Venus’s warmth. Dress in light colours for the puja. Full Moon in the Seventh
 With the full Moon opposite your sign, your partner’s feelings surface. They may want reassurance or more of your time. Ashwini’s quick energy suits honest, short conversations rather than long arguments. Mercury retrograde on your lagna can make your words come out wrong, so pause and rephrase if needed. Shani in the Sixth
 Retrograde Shani, your yogakaraka, in the sixth keeps health and routine steady while the lagna is crowded. Do not skip meals during the puja fast. Career and Jupiter
 Exalted Jupiter in your tenth supports your reputation. Debilitated Mars beside it warns against office arguments before Diwali. Do’s for Today
 Worship Lakshmi with a lotus and a ghee lamp.
 Give your partner time and reassurance.
 Don’ts for Today
 Avoid long arguments on the full Moon night.
 Do not skip meals while fasting.
 Shani Remedy for Today
 Donate a sewing machine to a woman starting her own tailoring work. Light seven small lamps around your home on Purnima night.
